description: Talent trees: 3 branches x 5 tiers per class. tools/talent_spec.py generated the first version; edit here from now on. Engine: scripts/resources/TalentManager.gd.

fields.name: tier_points
fields.help: Points that must be spent in a branch before each tier opens, e.g. [0, 2, 4, 6, 8].

fields.name: respec_gold_per_level
fields.help: Respec cost in copper = this x level.

fields.name: loadout_size
fields.help: Skills a character can take into battle.

fields.name: skill
fields.help: This node unlocks an active skill (then 'effects' is usually empty).

fields.name: effects
fields.help: List of effects per rank, e.g. [{"type": "stats", "stats": {"toughness": 3}}, {"type": "damage", "mult": 0.05, "with": "two_handed"}]. Types: stats, damage, defense, heal_bonus, lifesteal, skill, combo, status_chance, regen, mutate (change a skill: target, power_mult, add_status, set_status, add_element, turn_delay, hp_cost, after_use {heal_pct, mp_pct, sp_pct, self_status, self_turns}). See TalentManager.gd.

fields.name: choice
fields.help: Fork id: nodes in a branch with the same choice are mutually exclusive (mut2 = tier-2 skill mutation, t4 = tier-4 passive, mut5 = ultimate mutation).

fields.name: requires
fields.help: Node id in this branch that must be learned first (a mutation needs its skill).

fields.name: fork_alt
fields.help: Marks the added second option of the tier-4 fork.
